recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, black-and-white film photograph of a man in a cowboy hat, presented as a physical Polaroid print with a wide white border, set against a textured off-white background. The image features a candid, downward-looking pose with high-contrast shadows and a nostalgic, weathered texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a distressed Polaroid frame
High-contrast black-and-white photography against a warm-toned off-white canvas
Minimalist sans-serif typography anchored to the bottom corners of the photo frame
Heavy film grain unifying the internal image and the external border
coreInvariants: Polaroid-style white border with irregular, deckled edges
Monochromatic grayscale palette for the central image
Visible film grain and slight light leaks on the frame edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated, occupying the lower two-thirds of the central photographic frame, creating a sense of grounded intimacy.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark shape of the cowboy hat and the subject's black t-shirt provide a strong central weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the arm down to the watch, then moves outward to the text in the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space surrounds the central Polaroid, focusing all attention on the framed moment.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone Grays (Skin tones and background scenery)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the photo; high value contrast between the subject and the sky.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded terminals to mimic vintage printing

composition.position: bottom corners of the white frame
composition.relationshipToImage: anchored to the white border below the image area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospaced or single-family condensed sans-serif for a utilitarian, archival look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, utilitarian feel of vintage music packaging.
Provides the necessary weight and classic American aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black-and-white film photograph of a man in a black t-shirt and cowboy hat sitting outdoors. Place this photo inside a distressed white Polaroid frame with deckled edges. Set the entire Polaroid against a textured, light-cream paper background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase condensed sans-serif text in black. Place the artist name in the bottom-left corner of the white frame and the title in the bottom-right corner of the white frame, ensuring the text is small and aligned with the photo's edges.

verificationChecks: Is the photo strictly black and white?
Is the Polaroid frame distressed and off-white?
Is the text positioned in the bottom corners of the frame?
Is there visible film grain across the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Amount of light leak on the frame
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain does not look like digital noise.
Check that the text does not overlap the image area.
Verify the white border has irregular, non-perfect edges.
Confirm the background is a warmer white than the Polaroid frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Film Subject + Distressed Polaroid Frame + Condensed Sans-Serif Corner Typography + Textured Paper Canvas.
